name: Sol Rooftop
description: is a chic beachfront and rooftop pool club in Pererenan, Canggu, Bali, known for its ocean views, cocktails, and music. It features an infinity pool, comfortable seating, and a bohemian-chic atmosphere, making it a popular spot for sunset drinks and music, especially DJ sets and live bands. It offers both day and evening experiences, including food, drinks, and poolside relaxation.
note: This place is famous for its day-party which typically runs from midday into the evening.
priceRange: Free entry; bar-stools no minimum spend; other seating has ~IDR 200.000 minimum spend (from 14:00 on Wed–Sun & public holidays / special events)
